$comment: Route inventory of the strangler migration. `status`: migrated (a legacy route Nuxt now owns), legacy (still to migrate), nuxt-native (Nuxt capability that was never a legacy route — listed and file-checked like migrated, but excluded from the migration percentage), stays-legacy (deliberately not migrated, e.g. the JSON API the BFF consumes). `files` are the Nuxt files that implement a migrated or nuxt-native route; `npm run migration:status -- --check` fails when one is missing or when a page under app/pages is not listed here.

routes.note: Session owner and system of record. The BFF consumes it through shared/contracts.
